name: @justinhandley/ai-cli
description: CLI tool for AI operations including TypeScript file collection

scripts.version:major: tsx src/scripts/bump-version.ts major && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version to v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git tag v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git push && git push --tags && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && gh release create v$VERSION --generate-notes && npm publish
scripts.version:minor: tsx src/scripts/bump-version.ts minor && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version to v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git tag v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git push && git push --tags && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && gh release create v$VERSION --generate-notes && npm publish
scripts.version:patch: tsx src/scripts/bump-version.ts patch && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version to v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git tag v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git push && git push --tags && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && gh release create v$VERSION --generate-notes && npm publish
